description: This file contains unit tests for the Abseil library's PCG engine implementations, including golden value checks, seed and discard tests, serialization, and interface compliance.

classes.name: PCGEngineTest
classes.description: Template test fixture for PCG engine types, testing various properties and behaviors.

methods.name: VerifyReseedChangesAllValues
methods.description: Tests that reseeding the engine changes its output values as expected.

methods.name: VerifyDiscard
methods.description: Tests the discard functionality of the engine to ensure it produces consistent sequences.

methods.name: StreamOperatorsResult
methods.description: Checks that stream insertion and extraction operators work correctly for the engine.

methods.name: StreamSerialization
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of the engine state via streams.

methods.name: RandomNumberEngineInterface
methods.description: Verifies that the engine meets the C++ random number engine interface requirements.

methods.name: RandenEngineSFINAETest
methods.description: Performs SFINAE-based compile-time checks on engine constructors and seed functions.

methods.name: VerifyGolden
methods.description: Checks that the engine produces expected golden output values for specific seeds.

methods.name: VerifyGoldenSeeded
methods.description: Checks golden output values when the engine is seeded with a seed sequence.

methods.name: VerifyGoldenFromDeserializedEngine
methods.description: Verifies that deserialized engine states produce the expected output sequences.
